name: Play 3 Versus AI games
description: Finish 3 matches against the AI. Wins and losses both count.

name: Play 8 games
description: Finish 8 matches in any mode. Wins and losses both count.

name: Win 2 Ranked games
description: Take 2 wins on the ranked ladder.

name: Play 20 creatures
description: Play 20 creature cards from your hand across any mode.

name: Play 15 Teal cards
description: Play 15 cards from the Teal faction. Generic cards do not count.

name: Play 25 cards costing 3 or less
description: Play 25 cards with an effective cost of 3 or less.

name: Destroy 12 enemy creatures
description: Destroy 12 enemy creatures by any means - combat, challenge, or stratagem.

name: Deal 40 damage to enemy heroes
description: Deal 40 total damage to enemy heroes across any number of matches.

name: Win a game with 25 or more health left
description: Win a match without dropping below 25 hero health. Counts your best single match, not a running total.

name: Play 25 games
description: Finish 25 matches in any mode this week. Wins and losses both count.

name: Win 15 games
description: Take 15 wins in any mode this week.

name: Play 5 Legendary cards
description: Play 5 Legendary cards from your hand this week.
